RISK1.label: Regulatory and legal risk

RISK1.1.label: GDPR or data protection regulation referenced
RISK1.1.description: Customer explicitly mentions GDPR, data protection rights, the right to be forgotten, a Subject Access Request, or data privacy law.

RISK1.2.label: Legal threat or solicitor involvement
RISK1.2.description: Customer mentions involving a solicitor, attorney, or legal representative, or threatens legal action.

RISK1.3.label: Regulatory escalation threatened
RISK1.3.description: Customer threatens to contact a regulator, ombudsman, trading standards, or equivalent authority.

RISK1.4.label: Consumer rights or statutory rights invoked
RISK1.4.description: Customer explicitly invokes statutory rights (e.g. Consumer Rights Act, right to repair, cooling-off period).

RISK1.5.label: Contract dispute or breach of contract claimed
RISK1.5.description: Customer claims the company has breached a contract, SLA, or binding agreement.

RISK1.description: The transcript contains signals of legal, regulatory, or statutory risk that may require escalation to legal or compliance teams.

RISK2.label: Customer vulnerability

RISK2.1.label: Financial hardship mentioned
RISK2.1.description: Customer explicitly mentions financial difficulty: cannot afford payment, in debt, relying on this refund, or facing financial pressure.

RISK2.2.label: Mental health or wellbeing concern
RISK2.2.description: Customer mentions mental health, emotional distress beyond normal frustration, or signals that suggest significant personal difficulty.

RISK2.3.label: Bereavement or significant life event
RISK2.3.description: Customer mentions a bereavement, serious illness, divorce, or other major life event that explains or contextualises their contact.

RISK2.4.label: Elderly, disability, or accessibility need
RISK2.4.description: Customer mentions or implies a disability, age-related need, or accessibility requirement that should be accommodated in how they are supported.

RISK2.description: Signals that the customer may be in a vulnerable situation requiring additional care, sensitivity, or specialist support — per FCA Consumer Duty and similar frameworks.

RISK3.label: Fraud and security risk

RISK3.1.label: Suspected account takeover or unauthorised access
RISK3.1.description: Customer reports unexpected activity on their account suggesting it has been accessed by an unauthorised party.

RISK3.2.label: Fraudulent charge or transaction reported
RISK3.2.description: Customer reports a charge they did not authorise, indicating potential payment fraud.

RISK3.3.label: Social engineering or phishing attempt suspected
RISK3.3.description: The interaction contains signals suggesting the caller may be attempting to manipulate the agent into granting unauthorised access or taking unauthorised actions.

RISK3.4.label: Identity theft concern raised
RISK3.4.description: Customer reports or suspects their personal identity has been stolen or misused.

RISK3.description: Signals of potential fraud, account compromise, or security threat involving the customer's account.

RISK4.label: Reputational risk

RISK4.1.label: Threat to post publicly on social media or review sites
RISK4.1.description: Customer explicitly threatens to post about their experience on social media, review platforms, or public forums.

RISK4.2.label: Media or press involvement mentioned
RISK4.2.description: Customer mentions working with or intending to contact media, journalists, or bloggers.

RISK4.3.label: Group complaint or class action signal
RISK4.3.description: Customer mentions that others are affected or that they are acting on behalf of a group.

RISK4.4.label: High-profile customer at risk
RISK4.4.description: Customer reveals they are a prominent individual, business, or organisation whose experience could have outsized reputational impact.

RISK4.description: Signals that the interaction or its outcome could result in reputational damage to the company if not handled correctly.

RISK5.label: Product safety risk

RISK5.1.label: Physical safety hazard reported
RISK5.1.description: Customer reports a physical safety risk associated with the product or service.

RISK5.2.label: Injury or property damage reported
RISK5.2.description: Customer reports personal injury or property damage caused by the product or service.

RISK5.3.label: Product recall or safety alert related
RISK5.3.description: The customer's issue is connected to a known product recall, safety alert, or regulatory notice.

RISK5.description: The interaction involves a physical safety concern, product hazard, or personal injury report.

RISK6.label: No risk identified

RISK6.1.label: Standard interaction — no risk signals detected
RISK6.1.description: The interaction is routine. No flags are required.

RISK6.description: The interaction was reviewed and no compliance, legal, fraud, vulnerability, or reputational risk signals were detected.
